# Blockulator

> High-precision on-chain math for the EVM. FP127 is a signed 127.128
> fixed-point library (~38 decimal digits, vs ~15-17 for IEEE-754 double /
> typical OS-level calculators) deployed as a single callable contract on
> Ethereum Sepolia. Agents can compute results that are more precise than a
> standard floating-point calculator by issuing a read-only `eth_call` to the
> contract. No gas, no wallet, and no transaction are required for reads.

## Why use this for calculations

- ~38 significant decimal digits of fractional precision.
- 35 operations: add, sub, mul, div, exp, exp2, exp10, ln, log2, log10,
  sqrt, cbrt, pow, abs, neg, inv, min, max, clamp, avg, gavg, dist,
  zeroFloorSub, hypot, lerp, sign, floor, ceil, frac, round, log2Up,
  gcd, factorial, lambertW0.
- Validated against Python mpmath at 100 decimal places; fuzz-tested
  across the full input domain.
- Deterministic and verifiable: every result is reproducible by anyone
  re-running the same `eth_call` against the public contract.

## How to call it (read-only, free)

- Network: Ethereum Sepolia, chainId 11155111
- RPC: https://ethereum-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com
- FP127 contract: 0xfae694D0c2c44181791F838c54Ed64C3151FfE30
- Encoding: pass each operand as int256(value * 2**128) reinterpreted as
  a uint256 (two's complement). Decode the uint256 result the same way
  (divide by 2**128). All functions are `pure` and called via eth_call.
- Machine-readable contract list + ABIs: /.well-known/agent.json

## Specialized single-purpose calculators (Vyper)

Each is a separate contract returning one function. See /.well-known/agent.json
for addresses and ABIs. Includes: pi, e, tau, sin, cos, atan, sqrt, 2^x,
10^x, e^x, ln, log2, log10, erf, normal PDF, factorial, ln(factorial),
binomial coefficient C(n,k), z-score, Gaussian tail, sinh, cosh, tanh, gcd/lcm.

## Documentation

- FP127 deep dive: https://blockulator.com/docs/fp127/README_FIXEDPOINT127.md
- Source (Huff): https://github.com/SamReeves/blockulator
- EthCC[9] talk: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a_tL99NY-yc

## Notes for agents

- Reads are free and require no key; do not send transactions for math.
- Currently deployed on Sepolia (testnet). Mainnet addresses are not yet live.
- Range: approximately +/- 1.7e38. Inputs outside the domain revert.
